job.job_description:
Area(s) of responsibility

AI Architect Agentic AI / GenAI

Role Overview

Hands-on Architect responsible for designing and building scalable Agentic AI systems leveraging Python backends, Generative AI, and multi-agent orchestration frameworks.

Key Responsibilities
Design Agentic AI architectures (Planner, Supervisor, multi-agent workflows)
Build RAG systems with vector DB and semantic search
Develop Python backend APIs (FastAPI/Flask)
Implement LLM pipelines and prompt engineering strategies
Integrate agents with enterprise systems (APIs, DBs, tools)
Optimize performance (latency, cost, accuracy)
Drive best practices: code reviews, design, observability
Mentor team and guide architecture decisions
Required Skills
Strong Python backend development
Experience in Agentic AI / multi-agent systems
LLMs, prompt engineering, reasoning frameworks
RAG pipelines vector databases
Microservices API design
Azure/AWS/GCP AI services, Docker, Kubernetes
Experience

10+ years engineering, 3+ years GenAI experience, proven architecture expertise
